concerns.text: The core research question (VI) requires quantifying information loss by comparing a composition‑only GNN to a structure‑aware baseline. The plan explicitly defers the structure‑aware baseline because no open CIF source is verified, yet still claims to measure “information loss” (SC‑002). Without a structure‑aware model the ΔR² gap cannot be computed, so the methodology cannot answer the primary scientific claim.

concerns.location: plan.md:§ Benchmark against Random Forest baseline
concerns.text: Benchmarking only against a Random Forest baseline does not provide the required comparison to a structure‑aware GNN (FR‑006, SC‑002). This substitution changes the nature of the evaluation from “information loss due to missing structure” to a generic baseline gap, which does not satisfy the constitution principle VI.
